derivation.algorithm: SHA-256(version ASCII + NUL + domain UTF-8 + NUL + uint64 big-endian counter)
derivation.encoding: 0x followed by all 64 lowercase hexadecimal digest digits; never trim leading zeros

historical_inventory.scope: Seed values and hexadecimal seed filenames in known art archives; includes non-orbital render/material seeds conservatively. Source headers read without payload. Frames,checkpoints,vendor/builds excluded; new-cohort output excluded.

numeric_contract: Pinned native production exporter; cross-architecture identity requires separate verification.
selection_policy: All ten derived seeds are retained. Production candidate search is fixed for every seed. No visual seed filtering or rerolling.
